title: DDP reaches the top, then fights to stay there
summary: Years of climbing the card lead Diamond Dallas Page to the world championship. His reign quickly becomes a volatile battle with WCW’s established stars.

chapters.title: Page wins his first world title
chapters.result: DDP defeats Flair, Hogan and Sting in a four-way title match.
chapters.context: With Savage refereeing, Page finally reaches the championship that defines his rise from late starter to headliner.

chapters.title: Page loses and regains the belt
chapters.result: Sting defeats DDP, who regains the title in a four-way match later that night.
chapters.context: The second match also involves Nash and Goldberg; both title changes occur on the same Nitro.
